intentId.description: Stable server-owned intent identifier for the accepted withdraw lifecycle. Clients use this id to follow later progress for the same withdraw flow.

amount.description: Withdraw amount in canonical 18-decimal unified asset units. For example, 0.5 is encoded as 500000000000000000.

assetId.description: Unified asset identifier from Polyester asset metadata. amount_e18 is denominated in this asset at canonical 18-decimal scale.

deadlineTsSec.description: Unix timestamp in seconds after which this signed user authorization is no longer accepted by the API. This is separate from the server-owned execution deadline used later for on-chain submission.

destinationAddress.description: Destination address. For TO_EXTERNAL_CHAIN this is an address on destination_chain_id and is validated according to that network. For TO_FUNDING, omit it to move funds to the selected account's Funding account or provide another Polyester funding address for a Trading-to-Funding transfer.

destinationChainId.description: External network id for TO_EXTERNAL_CHAIN. Omit for TO_FUNDING.

idempotencyKey.description: Client-chosen idempotency key. Reusing the same key with the same payload returns the existing withdraw; reusing it with different payload fails.

nonce.description: Client-generated unsigned 128-bit nonce bound to the signed request. This is an identifier, not a decimal amount.

payloadSignature.description: Wallet EIP-712 signature over the typed withdraw payload.

subaccountId.description: Optional public subaccount id. Omit to withdraw from the JWT root account.

intentId.description: Stable server-owned intent identifier for the accepted withdraw lifecycle. Clients use this id to follow later progress for the same withdraw flow.
